thread:
Linh: Summarizing the follow-ups from the Cobalt Dedicated postmortem — root causes were VPC peering route asymmetry and an on-prem agent handshake regression. Posting owners, short timelines, and next checkpoints here.

Jon: I'll take lead on the peering route fixes and alerting changes.

Maya: I'll handle the on-prem agent timeout/relay fixes and the regression harness for the customer's air-gapped topology.

Priya: I'll own customer comms and scheduling; will propose maintenance windows.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: peering route fix -> staging @ 2026-03-25T22:30:00Z. Outcome notifications to this thread.

Linh: Action items (concise):
- A1: Fix route advertisement mismatch (owner: Jon) — target 2026-03-28.
- A2: Reduce handshake timeout + exponential backoff cap in on-prem agent (owner: Maya) — target 2026-03-26.
- A3: Add emergency circuit-breaker for cross-region routing to stop cascading failures (owner: Linh) — target 2026-04-02.
- A4: Nightly regression that replays the failing traffic signature against synthetic on-prem GW (owner: Maya) — target 2026-03-31.
- A5: Customer-facing timeline + optional maintenance window (owner: Priya) — draft 2026-03-27.
- A6: Add `peering_handshake_retries` metric + alert (owner: Jon) — target 2026-03-29.

Jon: My immediate plan:
- confirm route-map mismatch in infra repo (done)
- apply route advertisement patch to staging cluster
- run route validation and traffic replay script

Local validation snippet I'm using:
```bash
# verify peer route points to edge-primary
ip route show table 150
ip route replace 10.20.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.1 table 150 || true
```

Maya: On-prem validation plan: small Python harness that simulates high-latency + small MTU handshakes and asserts connection recovery < 3s. Will integrate as nightly CI job and attach PR. Patch will change handshake timeout 10s -> 5s and add exponential backoff with jitter.

Priya: Draft for customer comms: "We found a VPC route asymmetry plus an on-prem handshake regression that, under scale, can cause brief isolation for dedicated deployments. We're running staged fixes this week; will share a firm maintenance window after staging validation. — Priya"

Linh: Recurring-pattern notes:
- Flaps align with scale bursts (~8k+ RPS) and transient queue drops at customer edge.
- Combination of route distribution mismatch + brittle retry policy is the recurrent failure mode.
- Recommend tagging this pattern `peering-scale-handshake` and review in next quarterly reliability meeting.

sre-rotation-bot: Updated INC tracker -> INC-2026-132 assigned to Jon, severity P2.

Jon: Opening PR for alert and route fix today; will post staging logs here after canary finishes.

Maya: I'll open the regression test PR and tag eng-platform for a synthetic on-prem runner.

Linh: Please confirm ownership with reaction or reply. Weekly checkpoint will be in remediation-sync on Thursdays; I'll keep this thread as the action docket.

Jon: :+1:

Maya: :thumbsup:

Priya: Ack; posting draft in #customer-comm docs and will link once ready.

Linh: Thanks everyone. Closing note: once PRs merge and staging passes, we'll roll the fixes to production with a small canary percentage and monitor `peering_handshake_retries` and end-to-end request latency for 24 hours.
